titleFront: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)
titleBack: Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)

flipToBack.prose: Flip if Vader can be spotted at a battleground site AND no opponent Jedi, Padawan, or Luke can be spotted at a battleground site. Both spots use SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE. Differs from 7_297 by adding Filters.padawan to the blocker set.

children.req: card-spot: Vader at a battleground site
card-spot: any opponent Jedi, Padawan, or Luke at a battleground site
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.canSpot(game, self, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.or(Filters.Jedi, Filters.padawan, Filters.Luke), Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site)))

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if Vader is not on table, OR opponent has Luke, a Jedi, or a Padawan at a battleground site. A once-per-game consolation is mechanized on the FRONT class: on cardFlipped, if a site you control with Vader exists, may take Vader (and cards on him) into hand.

children.req: card-spot: opponent Jedi, Padawan, or Luke at a battleground site
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.canSpot(game, self, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.or(Filters.Jedi, Filters.padawan, Filters.Luke), Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site)))

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: canSpot presence semantics ('actor at location-type'), no control/occupy. Vader must be AT a battleground site (any, either player's).
Blocker: canSpot of opponent Jedi OR Padawan OR Luke at ANY battleground site prevents flip / forces flip-back. This V-version adds Filters.padawan versus the original 7_297 (Jedi|Luke only).
flipToFront: disjunction of Vader-off-table (NOT canSpot Vader) and blocker-arrival.

Once-per-game rescue: on the FRONT class, OptionalGameTextTriggerAction on TriggerConditions.cardFlipped(game, effectResult, self) gated by GameConditions.canSpot(game, self, Filters.and(Filters.site, Filters.controlsWith(playerId, self, Filters.Vader))): control-with semantics (a site you control with Vader); ReturnCardToHandFromTableEffect(targetedCard, Zone.HAND, Zone.LOST_PILE) [Card213_031.java:121-155].
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.or(Filters.Jedi, Filters.padawan, Filters.Luke), Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site)) (blocker set, INCLUDES padawan)
Filters.and(Icon.CLOUD_CITY, Filters.site, Filters.iconCount(Icon.DARK_FORCE, 1)) (required start deploy site)
Filters.and(Filters.character, Filters.not(Filters.or(Filters.droid, Filters.Imperial, Filters.bounty_hunter))) (owner deploy ban, both sides)
Back: Filters.and(Filters.Vader, Filters.armedWith(Filters.lightsaber)) (drain-bonus cancel condition); Filters.Visage_Of_The_Emperor (no Force loss)
setupAndPullRoutes: START OF GAME (front, required): deploy Vader's Castle: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.title(Title.Vaders_Castle), true, false) [Card213_031.java:65-71]

START OF GAME (front, required): deploy [Set 13] Visage Of The Emperor: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.and(Filters.Visage_Of_The_Emperor, Filters.icon(Icon.VIRTUAL_SET_13)), true, false) [Card213_031.java:72-78]

START OF GAME (front, required): deploy a [Cloud City] site with exactly one [Dark Side] icon: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.and(Icon.CLOUD_CITY, Filters.site, Filters.iconCount(Icon.DARK_FORCE, 1)), true, false) [Card213_031.java:79-86]

FRONT, once per owner's deploy phase: deploy a [Cloud City] or Malachor battleground site from Reserve Deck at ordinary cost: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.and(Filters.battleground_site, Filters.or(Filters.partOfSystem(Title.Malachor), Filters.icon(Icon.CLOUD_CITY))), true), GameTextActionId.HUNT_DOWN_V__DOWNLOAD_LOCATION [Card213_031.java:91-108]

FRONT (fires on flip), once per game: take Vader into hand from a site you control (cards on him: yours to hand, per ReturnCardToHandFromTableEffect(..., Zone.HAND, Zone.LOST_PILE)), GameTextActionId.HUNT_DOWN_V__TAKE_VADER_INTO_HAND [Card213_031.java:121-155]
otherObligations: FRONT+BACK: owner may not deploy characters except bounty hunters, droids, and Imperials: MayNotPlayModifier(Filters.and(Filters.character, Filters.not(Filters.or(Filters.droid, Filters.Imperial, Filters.bounty_hunter))), owner) [Card213_031.java:114, Card213_031_BACK.java:57]
FRONT+BACK: Inquisitors are destiny +1: DestinyModifier(self, Filters.inquisitor, 1) [Card213_031.java:115, Card213_031_BACK.java:58]

FRONT+BACK: where you have an Inquisitor, your total battle destiny +1 (+2 if battle at/with a card with a stacked 'Hatred' card): TotalBattleDestinyModifier(Filters.sameLocationAs(self, Filters.inquisitor), ConditionEvaluator(1, 2, OrCondition(DuringBattleAtCondition(Filters.hasStacked(Filters.hatredCard)), DuringBattleWithParticipantCondition(Filters.hasStacked(Filters.hatredCard))))) [Card213_031.java:116, Card213_031_BACK.java:59]
BACK: you lose no Force from Visage Of The Emperor: NoForceLossFromCardModifier(self, Filters.Visage_Of_The_Emperor, playerId) [Card213_031_BACK.java:55]

BACK: while Vader armed with a lightsaber on table, opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled: CancelOpponentsForceDrainBonusesModifier(self, OnTableCondition(Filters.and(Filters.Vader, Filters.armedWith(Filters.lightsaber)))) [Card213_031_BACK.java:52,56]
No hard-lose / place-out-of-play condition on either side (unlike 7_297: no Scanning Crew / duel / Executor-site drain landmines).
seedMismatches: 2026-07-08 seed omits the once-per-game take-Vader-into-hand rider (front class, cardFlipped trigger, requires a site you control with Vader); the K2 rows40-57 WIP seed does record it. No substantive mismatches in either seed's flip/flipBack laws.

profile.frontStructuredRule: preFlip/flip allOf: any Vader at a runtime battleground site in rules terms, and zero opponent Jedi, Padawan, or Luke at any runtime battleground site in rules terms; include excluded-from-battle cards
profile.backStructuredRule: postFlip/flipBack anyOf: zero Vader on table, or opponent Jedi, Padawan, or Luke at a runtime battleground site in rules terms; include excluded-from-battle cards
profileGaps: The permanent character deploy restriction remains engine legality rather than duplicated objective data.
The once-per-game recall remains engine game text. AI policy scores its exact live source and binds the physical Vader target, but does not duplicate the card's once-per-game legality.
The Inquisitor and Hatred destiny package is behaviorally scoped to the virtual objective in BattleDecisionPolicy, but it is not part of the flip-condition data.

missingStateCalculation: Front is complete only when a real Vader persona is at a runtime battleground site and no opponent Jedi, Padawan, or Luke is at any runtime battleground site. The battleground need not be controlled, and opponent-owned Vader also satisfies the source's unscoped actor spot.
A blocker at another battleground still blocks. A blocker at a non-battleground is irrelevant. A title containing Vader without Persona.VADER is not the actor.

After flip, Vader may leave the battleground and remain anywhere on table without causing flip-back. The missing state begins only when no Vader remains on table or a virtual blocker reaches any battleground.
flipPreservation: The exact virtual objective location-download action receives a positive parent contribution only when Reserve contains a Cloud City or Malachor runtime battleground accepted by the source filter.

Vader's Castle's exact Reserve Deck deploy receives +550 only when the engine finds a source-legal Vader candidate that can pay its ordinary deploy cost at Castle. An unavailable or unaffordable candidate receives -500.

Before flip, deploy and movement doctrine favor a legal runtime battleground destination for the last needed Vader. Landspeed, Vader's Castle, and the complete docking-bay transit parent/destination/mover chain use exact legal routes. Force-loss and battle-forfeit selection preserve that Vader only when another legal loss exists.
After flip, the last Vader anywhere on table is protected from avoidable forfeit. The exact Castle movement action may move Vader off a battleground because the back law requires only on-table Vader.
Safe battle scoring targets a remote Jedi, Padawan, or Luke blocker. Formation Safety, predictor defeat, effective power, low Reserve, and V25 anti-suicide boundaries remain absolute.
runtimeOwners: ObjectiveAnalyzer.assessFlipLocationRules owns the virtual allOf front law and anyOf back law with runtime battleground, controller-any actor, opponent blocker, and on-table semantics.

ObjectiveAnalyzer.hasVirtualHuntDownLocationDownloadInReserve mirrors the source's Cloud City-or-Malachor runtime battleground filter. PullSpecificActionPolicy PULL.OBJECTIVE.HUNT_DOWN_LOCATION_DOWNLOAD owns its parent score.

ObjectiveAnalyzer.classifyPreFlipProgressCandidate, getDeployObjectiveAdjustments, advancesPreFlipActorAtRuntimeLocation, and wouldCompletePreFlipRequirementAt own Vader pull, parent deploy, destination deploy, movement, and exact completion facts.
DeployActionTextPolicy V25-vader-castle-priority owns the Castle Vader action after ObjectiveAnalyzer proves an exact source-legal Reserve candidate can deploy there at ordinary cost.

MoveDestinationPolicy owns ordinary runtime battleground progress. The exact Card209_050 location-text route uses live GameTextActionState provenance, source blueprint 209_50, engine location-text legality, modifier-adjusted exact move cost, and both Formation Safety vetoes.

ObjectiveAnalyzer and the mirrored Combined, Move, and CardSelection evaluators own docking-bay transit. They preserve the exact source and selected physical destination across the engine's cancel-suffixed prompts, bind the exact mover, reject routes that break the sole required Vader, and clear provenance after completion.
ObjectiveBattlePolicy BATTLE.OBJECTIVE.GLOBAL_BLOCKER_REMOVAL owns the bounded safe battle against a remote virtual blocker. The Inquisitor/Hatred destiny heuristic is gated to this virtual profile.
ForceLossPolicy V21-objective and BattleForfeitPolicy BATTLE.OBJECTIVE.FLIP_GATE_FORMATION_HOLD preserve the required pre-flip or last on-table Vader.
Rando and Chosen One adapters call the same shared analyzers and policies.
contradictions: Printed Force icons are not runtime battleground truth. Every deploy, pull, and movement decision uses the live battleground filter.
The actor controller is any, not self. The blocker controller is opponent. The source does not require Dark Side control of Vader's site.
Virtual Hunt Down includes Padawan in its blocker filter. Classic Hunt Down does not.
Vader's Castle is not a battleground, but its location text can move Vader to and from another battleground. After flip, moving Vader back to Castle is legal and does not itself flip the objective.

The Castle Vader deploy is not free: the four-argument DeployCardToLocationFromReserveDeckEffect constructor treats its boolean as reshuffle and delegates with forFree=false. The AI therefore trusts the engine's exact deployability and current Force-cost calculation instead of a fixed six-Force proxy.
Vader is the complete count-one formation for this law. A generic buddy requirement would invent card text.
